title: Mulligan's Pub
venue_description:
Mulligan's Pub - Historic Irish Pub and Open Mic Destination

Venue Overview

Mulligan's Pub is an iconic Irish pub and dive bar in Eugene that has been a cornerstone of the local live music scene for decades. Located on Willamette Street the venue is known for its intimate stage and dedicated music community. The pub attracts serious music enthusiasts and musicians who appreciate the supportive atmosphere and authentic dive bar aesthetic. Mulligan's has earned its reputation as a proving ground for local musicians with generations of performers passing through its stage.

Music Events

The venue hosts one of Eugene's oldest and most established open mic nights every Tuesday evening from 7 PM to 11 PM. The Tuesday open mic features host Steve Ibach who has become a fixture in the Eugene music scene. Musicians from all genres perform including rock blues folk and original compositions. The open mic attracts a dedicated crowd of music heads who are known for their enthusiasm and support of fellow performers.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Mulligan's is a classic dive bar with a happy hour offering $3 local craft beer drafts between 4-6 PM on weekdays. The venue features a covered back patio where musicians often jam informally and locals gather. Pool table and classic dive bar entertainment round out the experience. The clientele is known as dedicated music lovers and performers who appreciate the authentic Eugene music tradition.

title: Beergarden
venue_description:
Beergarden - Community Beer Garden and Music Venue

Venue Overview

Beergarden is a community-focused beer garden and outdoor music venue located on the edge of Eugene's Whiteaker neighborhood. The venue features an indoor pub as well as an expansive outdoor beer garden complete with fire pits and a rotating selection of food trucks. The space celebrates craft beer community and live music making it a welcoming destination for all ages during daytime hours. The venue is family-friendly until 10 PM every night.

Music Programs

Beergarden hosts regular bluegrass and acoustic jam sessions throughout the week. Monday nights feature open bluegrass jams from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM featuring musicians from the Belltower band and other local players. The jam welcomes all skill levels and encourages musicians to bring their acoustic instruments. The venue also screens movies in the back garden area on Monday nights at 7 PM. Live music performances occur throughout the week with a focus on local bands and artists.

Atmosphere and Amenities

With 42 taps featuring craft beer cider mead kombucha and soda plus a rotating bottle selection there are diverse beverage options. The food court pod features five to six rotating food trucks providing meal options. Board games are available free to play all day on Mondays with both provided games and welcome bring-your-own options. The outdoor fire pit areas create a warm community gathering space. The venue is located near Gray's Garden Center making it easy to find.

title: PublicHouse
venue_description:
PublicHouse - Historic Community Gathering Space and Music Venue

Venue Overview

PublicHouse is located in a beautifully restored historic church building in downtown Springfield serving as a major community hub and cultural destination. The venue was designed to continue the building's tradition as a gathering space for the community. The restored space features multiple areas for different experiences while maintaining the architectural integrity and character of the original structure. The venue opened in 2018 and has become central to Springfield's cultural and dining scene.

Music Programs

PublicHouse hosts regular open mic events with music hosted by Amblin a legendary Eugene musician known for hosting open mics throughout the region. The Sunday open mic runs from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM with sign-up beginning at 5:30 PM and music starting at 6 PM. All ages and skill levels are welcome with musicians providing their own instruments while Amblin provides professional sound equipment. The outdoor lawn area is perfect for acoustic performances and the venue hosts bluegrass bands folk musicians and singer-songwriters. The venue also features performances from local bands like Belltower and other Americana and traditional music acts.

Atmosphere and Amenities

PublicHouse includes a beer hall whiskey lab and outdoor arbor bar with excellent craft beverage selections. A rotating selection of food vendors including Shalosh Tonalli Latin Kitchen Tiny's West Coast Black Market BBQ Sugar Kisses Desserts and Moi Poki Grill provide diverse meal options. The space is all-ages friendly and family-oriented with excellent food and beverage programs. Outdoor seating areas make it perfect for enjoying live music. The venue's co-working space and conference facilities add additional community value.

title: Gratitude Brewing
venue_description:
Gratitude Brewing - Downtown Brewery and Acoustic Music Venue

Venue Overview

Gratitude Brewing is a family-friendly craft brewery located in the historic Old Foundry building at the corner of 8th and Ferry in downtown Eugene. The brewery features a scratch kitchen with rotating food specials and a carefully curated selection of house-made craft beers. The venue combines excellent beer craft with culinary excellence and is committed to supporting the local music community. The atmosphere is low-key comfortable and welcoming to all ages.

Music Programs

Gratitude Brewing hosts regular bluegrass and acoustic jam sessions that rotate between two locations. The 2nd and 4th Wednesdays each month feature bluegrass jams from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM hosted by Corwin Bolt and friends. The 1st and 3rd Wednesdays are held at Oakshire Commons in Springfield. The rotating jam schedule allows musicians throughout the region to participate. These open jam sessions welcome musicians of all skill levels with acoustic string instruments. The venue also features live performances from bluegrass bands folk musicians and singer-songwriters throughout the week.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The brewery offers a rotating menu of house-made craft beers with options ranging from sour beers IPAs kolsch and everything in between. The food program features a talented chef creating unique flavors and specials that pair beautifully with the craft beers. A signature pretzel with homemade beer cheese is a must-try item. The location is prime for accessing downtown Eugene and close to the University of Oregon and 5th Street Market. Ample parking is available nearby. The venue is suitable for families and welcomes all ages.

title: Alluvium Church
venue_description:
Alluvium Church - Community Music and Social Justice Venue

Venue Overview

Alluvium Church is located in Eugene's Whiteaker neighborhood and serves as both a spiritual gathering space and community music venue. The church is dedicated to supporting local musicians and the unhoused population in the neighborhood. The venue provides a safe welcoming space for musical expression and community connection. Entry to music events is through the south door under the MLK mural creating an inclusive and accessible entrance.

Music Programs

Alluvium hosts Altered Reality a weekly open mic for musicians playing for musicians in a supportive community atmosphere. The event runs every Thursday from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. All forms of musical expression are welcome including folk rock blues jazz and experimental styles. Musicians range from beginners to seasoned performers and the focus is on creating a judgment-free supportive environment. There is no pressure to perform and listeners are equally valued as performers. The community emphasizes mutual support and encouragement of other musicians' efforts.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Alluvium provides adequate space for jamming and listening with good acoustics for music performance. The venue is drug alcohol and tobacco-free facility creating a clean safe space. The church community is welcoming to all people regardless of housing status or background. The connection to social justice work including support for the unhoused population makes this venue part of a larger community mission. The music program serves as healing and creative expression alongside community support work.

title: John Henry's
venue_description:
John Henry's - Intimate Downtown Music Bar and Venue

Venue Overview

John Henry's is an intimate music bar and venue located at 881 Willamette Street in the heart of downtown Eugene. The venue was re-established in 2022 and has quickly become a center for diverse live music performances. The intimate room puts audiences within feet of the stage creating close connections between performers and listeners. The venue is supported by punchy sound crisp lights and a friendly bar pouring Oregon craft beer and classic cocktails.

Music Programs

John Henry's hosts an eclectic mix of live performances including rock punk hip-hop indie singer-songwriter and experimental music. The venue features monthly spoken word open mics every second Monday from 6:30 PM featuring poetry prose short fiction and storytelling. Weekly open mic cover band nights occur every Tuesday at 9 PM for musicians wanting to perform covers in a fun supportive environment. The venue also hosts comedy showcases burlesque performances and DJ dance parties. The booking emphasizes diverse genres and emerging local talent.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The bar serves Oregon craft beer and classic cocktails with knowledgeable bartenders and friendly staff. The mostly standing-room layout creates an energetic atmosphere with limited seating. Street parking and nearby public parking lots serve the location. Arriving early is recommended for preferred viewing. Many shows are 21-plus unless otherwise noted. The venue's motto BEER.MUSIC.ART. captures its mission to celebrate all three elements. The intimate scale and diverse programming make it a destination for music lovers seeking diverse live performances.
